title: 第1章 重生第2章 永恒降临
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
“滴答，滴答…”
空旷的房间中，只有水滴声不断响起，此时还处于夏天阶段，空气中还残存着一丝燥热。
苏墨猛的从地上坐起，大口呼吸着新鲜空气，仿佛溺水者被救重获新生，连身上的衣服都被汗水浸湿。
下意识的警觉，心中一动，但等了一会也没有丝毫动静，苏墨有些茫然地看向四周，心里猛地一惊。
“这？这不是我以前打暑假工时，黑心老板勉强给住的地方吗？”
“我怎么会在这，我不是被偷袭了吗？”
“我这是重生了吗？”
左臂的印记也消失了，苏墨有些不敢置信，虽然从一阶摸爬滚打成为八阶强者有着很多诡秘的经历，但对这而言都只能是小巫见大巫了。
……
武极魔导苏墨，又号苏玄渊，是「永恒领域」阵营的八阶强者。
前世蓝星被「永恒领域」同化，苏墨在永恒蓝星里面战斗和修行了三百年，后又于宇宙以及各个位面闯荡两百年。
苏墨天赋异禀，同修魔法与武道，号称同阶不败，但只有他自己知道，「永恒领域」才是他迅速崛起的支柱。
在与一批小队同时探索位于深渊极东的废弃城池时，苏墨发现了一个有些破损的晶珠，晶珠里面还有一个小立方，立方中好似蕴含着一片星云。
整个晶珠散发着淡淡的微光，就在苏墨要鉴定这颗晶珠的时候。
猝不及防之下，遭受队友的背刺，“好队友”
准备多时，二话不说，上来施展的就是绝招，直指苏墨后心处。
苏墨早就知道队伍里有人不安好心，一路上总有目光，若有若无地落在自己身上。
组队是找一群人分担风险，每个人或多或少都有些小心思，一些多余的打量苏墨还真没太在意。
一起做任务也是无可奈何的事情，苏墨的修行体系有点问题，同修魔法和武道，前期问题不大，在尝试迈入九阶之时，两种能量在体内互相冲突，将苏墨一直卡在八阶巅峰，所以近百年苏墨一直活跃于比较危险的地界，不断做任务攒贡献点，就是想让「永恒领域」推衍出同修的方法。
其实只要放弃掉一种道路，就可以成功迈入九阶，但几百年的修炼，说放弃让谁来都不甘心，苏墨也是凭借的两种体系，在面对同阶强者时未尝一败，甚至对上一些较弱的高阶强者都能够过上两招。

单对单的话，苏墨还能轻松应付，但一些打斗的动静，惊动了附近的一队人，这些人犹如鲨鱼闻到了海中的血腥味，马上往这边赶。
苏墨发觉不对想溜时，却发现空间已经被封锁了。
最先背刺的那个人说苏墨发现了不得了的宝贝，让苏墨把东西拿出来，是不是宝贝看看就知道了，不是的也能解清误会。
苏墨看着他们一边说话一边包围自己，就知道这群人怕是还看上了他的庞大贡献点，战斗一触即发，最后在众人围攻之下，苏墨只能选择悍然自爆，随后意识仿佛坠入了无尽黑暗。
至于最后到底是谁拿到了这个晶珠，苏墨就不得而知了。
“伊藤佐井，不杀你难平我心头之愤。”
没想到同出自永恒蓝星，这个樱花国人想要自己的命，果然狗改不了吃*。
苏墨握紧拳头，感受到了自己此时弱小的身体，就连视线也有些模糊，可能最近长时间日夜颠倒的打工让他的视力也有些受损了，闭眼轻揉放松后，才感觉好一些。
content_en:
"Tick tock, tick tock..."
In the empty room, only the sound of water drops kept ringing. It was still summer, and there was still a trace of heat in the air.
Su Mo suddenly sat up from the ground, breathing in the fresh air, as if a drowning person had been rescued and regained a new life, even his clothes were soaked with sweat.
Subconsciously alert, his heart moved, but after waiting for a while, there was no movement at all. Su Mo looked around blankly, feeling suddenly startled.
"This? Isn't this the place where my black-hearted boss reluctantly gave me a place to live when I was working during the summer vacation?"
"Why am I here? Wasn't I attacked by surprise?"
"Am I reborn?"
The mark on his left arm also disappeared, and Su Mo couldn't believe it. Although there were many mysterious experiences from the first level to an eighth level strongman, they were nothing compared to this.
…
Martial Master Su Mo, also known as Su Xuanyuan, is an eighth-level powerhouse in the "Eternal Realm" camp.
In his previous life, the Blue Star was assimilated into the "Eternal Realm". Su Mo fought and practiced in the Eternal Blue Star for three hundred years, and then traveled around the universe and various planes for another two hundred years.
Su Mo is extremely talented and has practiced magic and martial arts. He is said to be undefeated at his level, but only he knows that the "Eternal Realm" is the pillar of his rapid rise.
While exploring an abandoned city in the far east of the abyss with a group of teams, Su Mo discovered a somewhat damaged crystal bead. There was a small cube inside the crystal bead, and the cube seemed to contain a nebula.
The entire crystal bead exuded a faint shimmer, just when Su Mo was about to identify the crystal bead.
Caught off guard, he was stabbed in the back by a teammate, "a good teammate"
After a long preparation, without saying a word, he came up and used a unique move, aimed directly at Su Mo's heart.
Su Mo had long known that there were people in the team with uneasy intentions, and there were always eyes on him along the way.
To form a team is to find a group of people to share risks. Everyone is more or less thoughtful, so Su Mo didn't really pay much attention to the unnecessary looks.
There is nothing we can do about doing missions together. There is something wrong with Su Mo's practice system. He practices magic and martial arts. The problem is not big in the early stage. When trying to enter the ninth level, the two energies conflict with each other in the body, keeping Su Mo stuck at the peak of the eighth level. Therefore, Su Mo has been active in more dangerous areas for the past hundred years, constantly doing missions to accumulate contribution points, just to let the "eternal realm" deduce the methods of fellow practitioners.
In fact, as long as you give up one path, you can successfully reach the ninth level. However, after hundreds of years of practice, no one is willing to give up. Su Mo also relied on the two systems to never lose when facing strong people of the same level. He was even able to survive two moves against some weaker high-level strong people.
Su Mo could easily handle it one on one, but some fighting noises alerted a group of people nearby. These people were like sharks smelling the smell of blood in the sea and rushed here immediately.
When Su Mo realized something was wrong and wanted to escape, he found that the space had been blocked.
The person who was the first to backstab said that Su Mo had found a great treasure and asked Su Mo to take it out. He would know if it was a treasure and could clear up the misunderstanding if it was not.
Su Mo watched them talking and surrounding him, and knew that these people were probably interested in his huge contribution. The battle was about to break out. In the end, under the siege of everyone, Su Mo could only choose to self-destruct brazenly, and then his consciousness seemed to fall into endless darkness.
As for who got the crystal bead in the end, Su Mo didn't know.
"Ito Saei, I can't satisfy the anger in my heart without killing you."
Unexpectedly, from the Eternal Blue Star, this Sakura countryman wanted to kill himself. As expected, dogs can't change their eating habits.
Su Mo clenched his fists, feeling that his body was weak at this time, and even his vision was a little blurry. Maybe his vision was somewhat damaged due to the long day and night work recently. After closing his eyes and relaxing them, he felt better.
